note: Record the documented LCD polarity difference separately from shared function values. Both module profiles remain distinct; G-9300-1 shared reference stays unresolved at exact model level.

modules.locator: PDF page 1 / E-3 About This Manual (LCD polarity); PDF page 11 / E-100–E-101 Specifications (shared functions)
modules.scope_note: Casio explicitly identifies dark figures on a light background as module 3261 and light figures on a dark background as module 3281. The common guide supplies the shared function specifications. Positive/negative are normalized LCD-polarity terms for those descriptions. User SEPULKRUM identified this distinction, then it was checked against the official guide. No exact module is assigned to a watch from a shared guide alone.
